verdict.rationale: The SDK is an open-source Python/JS library you can run anywhere and is 'provider-agnostic, supporting... 100+ other LLMs,' which supports self-hosted deployment. However, its built-in tracing sends data to OpenAI's hosted Traces dashboard by default, and several 'built-in' tools (WebSearchTool, FileSearchTool, CodeInterpreterTool) are OpenAI-managed services, meaning full independence from OpenAI's platform requires disabling default features rather than being the out-of-the-box mode.
